question: It’s one thing for Subaru’s Shamac work on a badly injured human-form Garfiel, but why would it work on beastform Garfiel?
answer: It’s the opposite. It wouldn’t have worked on human-form Garfiel. Beastform Garfiel is so much dumber that it works. Not only is Garfiel a half-beast, he didn’t properly learn the beastform method from his parent, so when he goes beastform, he becomes stupid. Ram took advantage of that as well to beat him up.
